text:
chao: FYI I'm planning a half-swap tonight to push router v4 behind the LB. change window 22:00-23:00 PT. keeping sticky cookie, short TTL

sophie: ack. what's the traffic plan? gradual?

chao: start 10% -> 30% (5m) -> 60% (10m warmup) -> 100% w/ 15m observation. drain old pool after 30m.

mira: recommend enabling health-probe warmup on v4 for 2xx + content-check. I'll attach probe string.

mira: probe: `GET /_health?probe=router-v4` expects 200 + header `x-router-id: v4`

deploy-bot: [deploy] router:v4 rollout initiated by chao at 3661234567 - phase=canary pct=10

jordan: pin rule for /admin and websocket routes to v3 until we confirm session-regen works. we don't want websocket reconnect storms.

priya: noted. i'll add pin: `routes: ["/admin","/ws/*"] -> pinned_version: v3` in routing-config for the change window

chao: also cold-start mitigation: keep 2 warm replicas per zone and disable preemptive scale-to-zero for 1 hour post-cutover.

sophie: what's the rollback threshold?

mira: p95 >= 250ms for 3 consecutive minutes OR error-rate > 0.5% on gateway metrics -> roll back 100% to v3.

jordan: add synthetic traffic check: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" \"https://router.internal/_probe?canary=1\"` should be 200 < 0.3s for 5 probes before moving >30%

deploy-bot: [monitor] synthetic-check passed (5/5) at 3661234630

priya: i'm prepping release notes in the release-docs repo. Will include new header behavior, sticky TTL change (30s -> 10s), and migration notes for session keys.

chao: important: during the 30->60% jump we'll enable prefix KV caching on v4. watch token cache hit ratio. if hit ratio drops >20% vs baseline, pause and revert to 30% until fix.

sre-oncall: i'll standby to adjust SLO gates and can pause routing if p95 spikes. ping me with `@sre-oncall pause` or toggle in the console.

mira: one more: for cross-region traffic, route 100% of eu-west traffic to v3 for the first hour (regional fallback) — do not include eu-west in the half-swap.

chao: copy. updated runbook:
```
1) kick deploy-bot canary 10%
2) verify synthetic probes and dashboard (p95, 5xx, cache-hit)
3) increase to 30% (5m) - check session stability
4) enable prefix cache on v4, wait 10m
5) jump to 60% if all green, observe 15m
6) 100% final and drain v3 after 30m
7) post-mortem note in #eng-releases
```

priya: release notes link: https://git.redwood/release-notes/router-v4 (draft)

deploy-bot: [deploy] router:v4 traffic advanced to 30% at 3661234700

mira: observing, p95 stable at 120ms, 5xx 0.02%

jordan: websocket test passed in staging, session regen token TTL honored

chao: if at any point we hit rollback criteria, we'll run: `deploy-bot rollback router:v4 target=v3 reason="perf"` - ops: be ready to run preflight for pinned routes after rollback

sophie: i'll announce a 10m heads-up in #general before the 60% jump

mira: reminder: update LB drain timeout to 45s to avoid premature disconnects during handoff

priya: adding post-cutover smoke checklist to the release notes (cache metrics, live traffic sample, error logs)

chao: thanks all. I'll start at 22:00. tagging @sre-oncall and @deploy-bot when we begin. :rocket:
